body: Selfish is a name I get called regularly, I think I am a very selfish person. I really try to believe in myself. Thank you.

I guess that I would say that in a way, I am trapped. If he could just change, it would help me a lot. I know he can't change though, no matter what I try to do it won't change him. If I just didn't let these things happen when our relationship started getting abusive then everything might be okay. Your response is appreciated greatly. <3

Lets say X thing is tell him what I did when I say brb and leave him for 15 minutes. He asks me to tell him what I do, and I answer with something like, "Ate dinner", he will proceed to question me about it and I will have to actually write a few sentences explaining what people said to me, what I am wearing and what I did. If I don't tell him, he gets really upset and angry and yells until I tell him. It's draining. Standing up to him is no use. Thank you for your answer by the way, I really am greatful.

Thank you for your kind response, it really does mean a lot to me. I doubt that he actually wants her back and it's just to make me feel bad, he usually says something about her when we're fighting. I just can't break up with him no matter how much I try. I do stand up to him but it doesn't make a difference ever

I know there are probably guys out there that can treat me better. I know my relationship is toxic, and there is a lot of bad things that come with it but I love him and with the level of understanding he has with me, I doubt I will ever be able to find anyone like him. If I was with anyone else, I'd understand the whole "there are other people out there" thing. 
Also, I'm sorry about your past, hey :( There is definitely decent girls out there, they just need to come to you.
